description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thorayaya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420211 (22/55064)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land registration information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers for multiple properties across different districts. The content focuses on the legal process for registering title to land properties of deceased persons without wills, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
